_help: Per-game config. Add a game = add an entry. 'enabled': false keeps a game prepared but silent (switch it on with the ENABLE_GAMES variable, or it switches itself on at 'auto_enable_on'). 'four_star_count' = rate-up 4-stars per banner phase: any other count found -> TBA. Card text templates: {game} {version} {program} {version_name}. Every endpoint/id below was verified live on 2026-09-25 (see docs/SOURCES.md). 'reveal_ping': false keeps a game out of the opt-in NEWS_REVEAL_PING reveal mention; Wuthering Waves is false because its official site repeats the reveal the twitter/X pipeline already delivers as a card, and that pipeline has no reveal ping yet.

hna.name: Honkai: Nexus Anima
hna.note: Switched ON 2026-10-02, before launch, so pre-release Special Programs and codes are caught the moment they appear (a newly enabled game seeds its state silently on the first run, so nothing old is posted). No release date announced as of 2026-10. HoYoLAB gid 9 and X @HonkaiNA are wired; official YouTube @HonkaiNA (hoyolab.com/article/41196864). HoYoverse has announced no Twitch channel for it, so the card simply has no Twitch button. At launch: set launcher to {"type": "hoyoplay", "game_id": "yneO4yGc4x"} (HoYoPlay getGames already lists it under that id, biz abc_global, 2026-11-07 — one background, no branch yet; wiring it before a branch exists would only add a getGameBranches re-fetch to every maintenance run), add Twitch, the hoyo-maint gateway (MAINT_STATUS) once known, and code sources (seria/ogc once they list it).

ananta.name: ANANTA
ananta.note: Switched ON 2026-10-02, ahead of the 2027-01-15 global launch (confirmed at gamescom ONL 2026; NetEase / Naked Rain), so pre-launch livestreams and codes are caught; auto_enable_on is kept as a safety net in case this flag is ever set back to false. A newly enabled game seeds its state silently on the first run. Official YouTube @Ananta_Game (neteasegames.com press releases); NetEase lists no Twitch channel, so the card has no Twitch button. No gacha character unlocking -> banner section hidden. At launch: set four_star_count if that ever changes and add more code sources.

nte.name: Neverness to Everness
nte.note: Added 2026-11-27. Feature 3 is LIVE: the official news archive is static, server-rendered HTML (nte.perfectworld.com/en/article/news/, tabs gamenews/gamebroad/gameevent, indexN.html pagination) and sources/perfectworld.py reads the list, the article title, the article body and its cover with no JavaScript and no API key; the printed date is ignored in favour of the day in the article URL. Feature 2 is LIVE: ogc:nte is a known game that currently answers [] = no live codes, plus the community listing as a second witness that never posts alone. Feature 1/4 are inactive because no HoYoLAB gid, launcher/mantenance gate or version cadence was verified for this title. Handle evidence (2026-11-27, committed under tests/fixtures/probes/): @NevernessToEverness is a YouTube channel whose page title is the game and x.com/NTE_EN is an existing account (NTE_Game returns no account) -- neither is linked from the server-rendered site, so confirm both once in Settings before trusting an X-only card.

endfield.name: Arknights: Endfield
endfield.note: Added 2026-11-27: codes are READY (ogc:endfield answers 5 live codes with rewards and no expiry), and the banner line-ups already travel through Kitsudock-data hub.json like the other games. Feature 3 is BLOCKED at the publisher, not here: endfield.gryphline.com/en-us/news renders titles, dates and covers but every href is empty, and the CMS call the client makes (GET /api/bulletin?lang=..&code=<appCode>) answers 'Cannot GET /api/bulletin' (404) on endfield.gryphline.com, web-api.gryphline.com and /api/bulletin/1 alike -- cms.appCode is not in any captured chunk. Feature 3 therefore reports 'no verified source (inactive)' on every run until the publisher exposes one. Features 1/4 stay inactive until a version cadence or a launcher gate is verified. Handle evidence (2026-11-27, committed under tests/fixtures/probes/): @ArknightsEndfield is a YouTube channel whose page title is the game and x.com/AKEndfield is an existing account (ArknightsEndfield returns no account) -- neither is linked from the server-rendered site, so confirm both once in Settings before trusting an X-only card.

silverpalace.name: Silver Palace
silverpalace.note: Feature 3 only, and prepared rather than enabled: the page confirms the 2026-12-14 global launch, but silverpalace.elementagames.com/en-us/news is a Nuxt site whose _payload.json is a 69-byte placeholder and whose __NUXT_DATA__ carries only i18n/site config -- no news entry exists in the server output at all, so there is nothing to parse and no fallback to reach. No X account, YouTube channel, code source or maintenance gate for this title could be verified either (api.ennead.cc/codes/silverpalace is a 404). Re-probe after 2026-12-14 for a hydrated news endpoint; the Reddit listing is the only witness wired, and it never posts alone.
